question: In a certain code language, CRICKET is written as ZOFZHBQ. How will FOOTBALL be written as in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/768ffa75a91f088695c16a6deb50b713a526fcdb17ebb80961c20654cb850baa.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

Letters are decreasing by -3.

 
• In CRICKET → ZOFZHBQ 

 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fba5b4107eebb8fc1bfb8188299b0de515fa483da35af9f9586c82d529c1ba77.png] .​​​ 
 
 
 
• Similarly, In FOOTBALL → ? ​
 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/271b86805630be0aabf549f723575af72a8cadbe00b53dc444a38e3c992d9898.png] 
 
 

We get 'CLLQYXII'.

Hence, Option 2) is the correct answer.
